description: List the DNS records of a domain (id, name, type, content, ttl, priority/weight/port, linkedService) plus the parking page state. mode managed or cloudflare-protected = records are editable with the DNS tools; read-only = the domain uses external nameservers, manage its records there. Records with linkedService belong to a server link or One-Click Apps and cannot be changed here. Read-only. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).
name: get_domain_dns_records
title: Get Domain DNS Records
